title: Man Utd's 1999 final XI
brief: Name the ten outfield players who started for Man Utd against Bayern Munich in the 1999 Champions League final (26 May 1999), when they won 2-1. The goalkeeper (Peter Schmeichel) is left out.

notes.Teddy Sheringham: Teddy Sheringham came on as a substitute in the 1999 final, so he did not start.
notes.Ole Gunnar Solskjaer: Ole Gunnar Solskjaer came on as a substitute in the 1999 final, so he did not start.
notes.Roy Keane: Roy Keane was suspended for the 1999 final.
notes.Paul Scholes: Paul Scholes was suspended for the 1999 final.

checks: Starting XI, positions and shirt numbers from the team sheet on the final's Wikipedia page; the same eleven players and shirt numbers are on the Transfermarkt match report. Positions are Wikipedia's.
